Hi Alan and team,

Thanks again for taking the time last week. As discussed, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (Finovate_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a proposed SLA for the Dedicated pilot (SLA_proposal.pdf). The MAP outlines three phases: kickoff + discovery, evaluation (integration + throughput tests), and go/no-go.

High-level asks for kickoff:
- Confirm the new internal champion and primary technical contact (name/email).
- Share a representative test dataset and example traffic profile (anonymized).
- Procurement timeline / contract questions so we can align the pilot start.

Proposed kickoff window: May 27–29. If that doesn't work, tell us the earliest available week. Vivek will run the technical agenda, and Hannah will own the MAP milestones and calendar.

Attachments: Finovate_MAP_v1.xlsx, SLA_proposal.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa

Hi Priya / Alan — welcome and thanks for the intro, Alan. Priya — great to e-meet you. I’m Hannah (Sales Ops / MAP owner for this account). Marissa and Vivek are copied; we’ll run the commercial and technical workstreams, respectively.

We understand there was an internal reshuffle — thanks for the heads up. To make this as light as possible for your new champion, we propose a short re-kick with three concrete outcomes:

1) Roles & owners: confirm the champion (Priya?), technical lead for integration, procurement contact, and security contact.
2) Scope alignment: pick a single evaluation use-case (documented in the MAP) and confirm the MLP success criteria (latency, throughput, and qualitative quality checks).
3) Updated timeline: a pragmatic 6-week evaluation with key milestones — kickoff sync (1 week), integration & test (weeks 2–4), verification & procurement (weeks 5–6).

Proposed actions before our re-kick call:
- Priya: confirm you are the champion (or introduce the correct person) and share availability for a 30‑minute sync this week.
- Finovate security: please confirm whether the standard questionnaire we sent previously is still the right starting point or if you need an updated package.
- Finovate procurement: any contract milestones we should be aware of (PO, legal review windows).
- Finovate technical team: a representative sample dataset (+ schema) and an approximate QPS profile.

I’ve attached a trimmed MAP (MAP_v2_revised_schedule.xlsx) with the proposed 6‑week timeline and the two milestone gates we recommend. If the timeline above looks aggressive, we can stretch it — our aim is to align on a clear path to a pilot decision.

Proposed kickoff slots (all PT):
- Tue 28 May, 3:00–3:30pm
- Wed 29 May, 10:00–10:30am
- Thu 30 May, 9:00–9:30am

Please reply with a preferred slot and confirm the list of stakeholders you want on the kickoff. If it helps, Vivek and I can prepare a 15‑minute technical pre-read to reduce the live meeting time.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt | Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0133

Attachments: MAP_v2_revised_schedule.xlsx

Hi Hannah / Marissa / Vivek — thanks for the clear note and for holding the MAP. I’m Priya Rao and I’ll be the Finovate champion for this evaluation. Short answers below and a couple of asks:

- Champion: yes, I’ll own the evaluation. My calendar is open for Tue 28 May 3:00pm PT — that works.
- Technical lead: looping in Alan for any additional technical stakeholders; I’ll bring in our lead engineer (we’ve copied him to the calendar invite after we confirm).
- Security: our security inbox (security@finovate.ai) will handle the questionnaire; please send any updated artifacts to that address.
- Procurement: procurement@finovate.ai is copied. We typically need ~2–3 weeks for standard SOW review once scope is locked.
- Dataset: we can share a 24‑hour sample traffic export (anonymized) by Wed EOD.

Quick ask: can you update the MAP success criteria to include a throughput target (min 150 qps sustained for 10 minutes) and an integration checklist item for prefix caching? I’ll confirm the exact numbers with my engineer but want that captured.

I’ll accept the 3:00pm slot and look forward to the kickoff.

Thanks,
